test_title: PYST 26 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B together do a piece of work in 10 days. B alone does it in 15 days. How long will A take alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together = 10 days

Time taken by B alone = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

⇒ To
